resolution.title: [ptf_adapter] prolong ptf availability check timeout
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #4571

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [x] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] Test case(new/improvement)

### Back port request
- [ ] 201911

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Prolong ptf availability check timeout, otherwise, if ptf_nn_agent is not started in 1s, the test case failed.
#### How did you do it?
Prolong the timeout to 10s from 1s.
#### How did you verify/test it?
Rerun test case and passed.
